name: @buildpilot/desktop-tauri
description: BuildPilot system-tray desktop app (Tauri v2) — runs the server in the background, shows pipeline notifications, and opens the dashboard from the tray. Rust-native rewrite of the Electron app.

scripts.dist: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run prepare:resources && tauri build
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run prepare:resources && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run prepare:resources && tauri build
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run prepare:resources && tauri build
